name: Alila Diwa Goa
positioning: Contemporary Goan resort of laterite stone and teak in Majorda, South Goa, with an infinity pool overlooking rice paddies, 500 meters from Gonsua Beach
best_for: Families who want a kids' club and a teen zone
Travelers who want village and culture experiences around South Goa
Guests who want a quieter resort-within-a-resort at The Diwa Club

facts.text: The resort is in the historical district of Majorda in South Goa.
The architecture is contemporary Goan, using local materials including red laterite stone and teak.
Open-sided, high-ceilinged public spaces are cooled by reflecting pools and fountains.
All rooms have a balcony with views of the pool, gardens or paddy fields.
Loft Rooms are furnished in a contemporary wooden loft style with a touch of Goan tradition.
The Diwa Club has its own pool with an open-air jetted tub.
Spa Alila offers a blend of Asian, Western and Ayurvedic treatments.
The Yoga Studio overlooks lush greenery.
Play Alila is the resort's kids' club, with activities and curated experiences for kids 12 and under.
The Teen Zone, next to Play Alila, has table tennis, foosball, carrom, chess and scrabble.
The Alila Mini-Theatre has daily movie screenings.
Spice Studio serves the coastal cuisines of Kerala, Karnataka and Goa and is built around a banyan tree.

highlights.text: The infinity pool has partially submerged recliners and overlooks rice paddies and bamboo stands.
The Diwa Club is a pet-friendly resort within a resort inside Alila Diwa Goa.
An Alila Moment takes guests on a walk from the resort to a village bakery to learn Goan breadmaking.
An Alila Moment tours a working feni distillery with maker Mr. Hansel.
The resort has high-pitched roofs, wide verandas and tranquil courtyards.

considerations.text: The resort is not on the beach; Gonsua Beach is 500 meters from the resort.
Conde Nast Traveler notes the rooms are not well soundproofed.
Conde Nast Traveler notes tour groups can diminish the exclusive feel.
